lessons: The premise is false. The ticket says 'timing and coverage still come from the first run', but clutch/covgate.py run_gate (lines 146-148) returns pytest's nonzero rc before it checks thresholds. A first run with a failed test never evaluates coverage. Only the old full-suite rerun did.

The config.yaml unit entry wraps pytest in `clutch coverage gate`. A --clutch-select rerun runs one test, so the gate fails coverage thresholds and exits nonzero even when that test passes. Under this fence, keeping the rerun rc-finding line gives false failures, and dropping it weakens the gate.

Re-scope before another attempt: fence clutch/covgate.py and tests/unit/test_covgate*.py. Choose one: run_gate evaluates the report even when pytest's rc is nonzero, or Check evaluates the first run's coverage report after a selected rerun clears every failure. State the choice in the Boundary
